Same-process unknown-receipt retry appends exactly once

observations: B03 exercises all 120 permutations of five supplied records plus duplicates, not all possible histories.
B01 opens frozen 22-event stable v3 fixture through production TaskStore; cache reopen reads zero old log bytes and original canonical hashes/writer identity remain.
B13 actually restores full native pending state, then compares tail replay and a fresh Dart OS process using journal-only input.
B14 production old TaskStore rejects unknown required event without advancing events/stream checkpoints or rewriting input.
B16 preserves raw future clock; existing production warning test separately proves readable immutable future records and warning permits writes.
B19-B22 preserve captured scalar draft value/selection/composition, reject implicit native reattachment and composing Save, then explicitly open new native capture.
fixed_reproduced_defects: Idempotent retry attempted to delete an already removed prepared file.
Checkpoint restore returned the cancelled original native field handle.
Baseline admitted unresolved historical Undo dependency.
Same-process unknown-receipt retry appended an already complete record again.
Incomplete owned journal tail allowed further writes.
remaining_gates: Single issuer/reference is explicit test configuration; production bootstrap agreement and UX are not designed or approved.
Synthetic private POSIX JSONL journal/JSON checkpoint is not production SQLite/SAF/transport integration.
Interrupted native Undo durability is not implemented: current happy-path compensation applies native Undo before append.
Durable actor ownership/collision registry, bounded native resource policy and parser isolation remain open.
New prepare/apply_local paths and coordinator have not run on Windows or Android.
No process-death durability promise for unsaved drafts; no automatic incompatible-root merge.
Existing Android editor-lab acceptance is partial parent-reported evidence for its older exact APK, not this coordinator.
